v.n: Sesame Street Season 56: Available November 10 on Netflix…
N is for NETFLIX! Sesame Street is getting a new neighbor!

eps.o: The Sesame Street Races are about to begin! The winner will get a sparkly gold medal, but Elmo's so excited he forgets to fuel up with healthy food.
It's Cookie Time... but Cookie Monster and Tamir can't figure out why Elmo doesn't want one! Abby helps Grover learn that doing puzzles takes patience.
While Abby and Elmo work together to find a lost Bubble Bug, Grover and Cookie Monster stay behind to take care of the fairy garden's Magical Beasties.
Elmo's sad his daddy has to go on a work trip, and Grover's on a mission to cheer him up — but it isn't working. Sounds like a job for the Help Fairies!
After trading old toys with his pals, Elmo learns there are lots of ways to play and pretend. Later, Miley Cyrus helps the gang use their imaginations.
While watching baby dragons for the first time, Abby, Elmo and crew join voices for a soothing bedtime bop to make sure the little beasties go to sleep.
Elmo's bike is great, but is Abby's bike even better? Tamir teaches Elmo how to deal with feeling jealous — and to enjoy the things Elmo already has.

eps.t: Elmo and the Great Cookie Stack
eps.o: Elmo and friends have until the end of the day to set the record for the tallest cookie tower ever! Can they work together as a team to make it happen?
It's a super hot day, so Elmo and friends stay inside and learn to beat their boredom together, using everyday items from the store to build a mini city.
Cookie Monster's cookie cart is now open, and his mommy stops by to help! Can Cookie find a way to tell her she doesn't need to do everything for him?
Blast off on a speedy rocket ship as Space Captain Elmo leads Abby, Cookie Monster, Grover and Rudy on a mission to Jupiter using their imaginations.
All the world's a stage — especially on Sesame Street! Grover directs a play starring his pals, but everyone must work together to put on the show.
Pushing his cookie cart around gives Cookie Monster a workout. Will Abby's fairy magic make the cart easy to move without causing too much trouble?
